start_with: Find the `Communication` record.
Check status: draft, pending approval, approved, sent, failed, or future-dated.
Check `FutureSendDateTime`.
Check approval state and approver permissions.
Check Communications Send Job state and history.
Check recipient rows: are there pending recipients?
Check medium entity type on recipients.
Check transport active/configured state.
branches.title: A communication did not send

start_with: Identify recipient source: list, communication, grid, entity set, workflow, connection requests.
If list-based, inspect group membership and active status.
Check deceased status.
Check segments and AND/OR match behavior.
Check duplicate removal.
Check email/SMS/push eligibility.
Check communication type changes during wizard authoring.
Check v18.2 recipient exclusion fix if the user changed communication type mid-wizard (Rock Release Notes).
branches.title: Some recipients are missing

start_with: Confirm the send created `CommunicationRecipient` records.
Confirm it used the expected email medium.
Confirm transport supports analytics.
Confirm tracking is enabled for this send path.
Confirm provider webhooks/callbacks.
Confirm Rock has opens/clicks in the relevant analytics table or model.
Compare with a wizard-sent test email.

If workflow-sent, verify whether the workflow action path supports communication analytics. A community Q&A reports this exact difference for Mailgun but does not provide a confirmed fix in the source pack (Mailgun Tracking Q&A).
branches.title: Email delivered but analytics are missing
branches.when: Email delivered but analytics are missing

start_with: Check provider inbound webhook delivery.
Check SMS Pipeline.
Confirm SMS Conversations action is present.
Check system phone number.
Check conversation block filters and allowed numbers.
Check assigned person and personal-number filters.
Check conversation age/month limit.
Check page/block security.
branches.title: SMS reply is not visible

start_with: Check recipient `CommunicationRecipient` status and status note.
Check person's phone record.
Confirm mobile phone type.
Confirm SMS enabled state.
Confirm opt-out state.
Confirm bad-number provider errors.
Confirm From number and provider send logs.
Check whether the UI only appeared to send. Community experience shows staff can miss pending/failure state without stronger UI warnings (Disabled SMS Mobile Phone Warning).
branches.title: SMS recipient did not receive message
branches.when: SMS recipient did not receive message

start_with: Check template active state.
Check category filter.
Check template permissions.
Check whether template supports the wizard.
Check template version.
Check block allowed communication types.
Check whether it is a Communication Flow template rather than a system-wide Communication Template.
Check whether the current user has edit/view rights, as the official manual notes templates may be hidden by permissions or setup (Communicating With Rock).
branches.title: Template is missing from wizard

start_with: Check page and block security.
Check whether the user created or sent the communication.
Check Communication Detail `Communication Access Mode`.
Check `View All` security action in v19.1+.
Check whether strict access is expected.
Review release notes and tech bulletin for the current version (Rock Release Notes).
branches.title: User cannot view communication detail

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
